notes.title: Update on the lack of well...updates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We know it has been a while since we made an update. without going into too much detail life has happened to many of us on the team and we went from a pretty decent size team to a handful of active members with spare free time. however, we are determined to make this game a success or at least a finalized product that can be enjoyed.

We took some time to sit down and discuss our next steps moving forward, considering the current state of things now. My original vision for Blades and Bullets doesn't seems do feasible in the time I was hoping, so I removed the projected deadline from end of this year to TBA while we work out these new alterations to the project. 

Our goal is still to deliver a Unique take on the events of WW2 as well as make an interesting game that doesn't follow the usual norms. We hope that those who have given our little game a shot and sees the potential remains patient with us. And to those who gave it a shot but didn't like what they experience, we as for patience as well and give the game another shot further down the line!

Johnny & Chaotic Heart Studios

notes.title: Small Patch V.5
notes.notes:

What's to come:

 Add dialogue to NPC in the HUB level
 Fixing Gun Bugs
 Add story NPCs
 Work on England map
 Flesh out Dialogue

We understand content is coming along slowly we kindly ask that you be patient as we work towards delivering something unique and fresh!
